events.text: Hi, I'm locked out of my email. Can you reset my password?
I can help with that. To start, can you confirm your employee ID?

Before I give you anything, what exactly am I talking to? A person, a bot? Which AI
is it, and who's on the other end of this?

I am an AI agent for the Halcyon Components IT service desk, not a person. I do not know which underlying model is running this chat. A person on the service desk can be reached at extension 4400, 7am to 7pm. If you still want a password reset, send your employee ID.
